notes.title: Voice over and subtitle update
notes.notes:
[b]Message from the localization team[/b]


You shared your thoughts, and we listened:) We added a new voice over and subtitles!

Hi guys! I'm Rie N. Liotta (I'm from Japan, based in NY), and I had the great pleasure to be a part of the localization team for "Lurk in the dark" Episode: "The Guilty"! I've been playing video games since I was six years old, and the first game I've ever played was Clock tower on Super Famicom! It's a dream come true to be translating games, and I had the most fun localizing this piece of art and working with Mr. Hamazaki, the creator of this game!

So we've got a lot of comments about the voice over and subtitles, and we've taken action (Ka-pow!).

[b]Update:[/b]

[b]・In the game settings, you can now choose to play with Japanese or English voice over! This time, we localized the game instead of technical translation like it was before.

・We added Japanese voice over with revised and improved English subtitles. We recommend this setting to those who want to focus on the story with a truly immersive experience!

・We also revised the English voice over. We kept the funny accent (but better English;) for those who want to get a good laugh throughout the game:)[/b]


We hope you'll enjoy the nightmare a little better this time! Thanks to all your feedback, we're able to fix and make things better! And keep 'em coming! We're always listening, and you can make a difference!

There were also a lot of comments about how short the game was. We want you to know we're working on that too! We're doing our best to make this a full game and make it available to all the horror gamers in the world! We put our lives on the line to make this nightmare come true! 

We thank you all so very much for your continuing love and support! Wish us luck and always remember, "Fear not the dark itself, but what may lurk within it."


Stay tuned,
"Lurk in the dark" localization team

notes.title: Slight Update.
notes.notes:
Some words in English subtitles were incorrect, so we fixed them.

■ When the desk opened, the subtitle "I'm jenious" appeared, but it was correctly "I'm genius".

Really sorry for terrible English!

A person who does Japanese-English translation has contacted me and is currently working on translation.

This is all thanks, to the reviews of everyone who said the English is terrible but the game itself is interesting.

Thanks...and...Thanks!!

Along with that, Japanese voices will be added.
Because I thought it would be easier to read subtitles while listening to Japanese rather than listening to English(?) whose pronunciation was strange.

It is a story after crowdfunding is successful, but in the product version you can enjoy it with native English and English voice from the beginning. haha :)

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: UPDATE AND IMPORTANT NEWS!!!
notes.notes:
Updated to improve convenience and performance!

Update contents are as follows


① Added operation guide to item menu.
By pressing the G key, display / non-display can be switched.
Accordingly, the video and description of the tutorial have been changed.

② When approaching an object that can cause an action, such as a door or an object, a guide appears at the lower right.

③ The mouse operation guide (rotation, enlargement, movement) is now displayed when examining items.

④ Improved posture change and brought it closer to general FPS operation.
[C key pressed fast: Crouch / Stand up] [C key held down: Crawl]
    Along with this, the tutorial video and description have been changed.

⑤ A performance drop occurred while the iron elevator was descending, so it was corrected to improve the performance.

⑥ The condition for the last girl to come out has been further relaxed.


Thank you very much for your feedback!
In the product version, we will make use of the tendency gained from these mistakes, and we will do our best to enjoy you the first time you play the game.

And now, the person who volunteers for the Japanese-English translation has spoken to me, so I think you can enjoy Lurk in the Dark : Prologue in perfect English in the near future!

[b]And this is important news!!!
[u]If the ongoing crowdfunding fails, the development of Lurk in the Dark ends.[/u]
If you would like to play the future story of Lurk in the Dark, please support me!!!! 
Please....Please.....HELP ME....!!![/b]

English(?) description page in here!

Prologue is really immature compared to the story and gameplay in the future.
When you finish playing the production version and see the end roll, you will surely be crying. (lol)
Of course not because it's scary.
Because it is impressed.

Why do you know that?
Because I'll cry immediately when I imagine the future story of Lurk in the Dark. Hahaa:)

notes.title: UPDATE INFO
notes.notes:
Applied a little big update!
The main content is the elimination of parts that were difficult to understand or inconvenient.
Even if you have cleared the game once, if you look around again, you may find something new. :)

The contents of the update are as follows


■ When using highlights, an easy-to-understand icon is displayed on the item to improve visibility and at the same time understand the importance of the item.
Along with this, the tutorial video and TIPS images have been changed.


■ When using highlights, some objects needed for the story progress have been changed to be highlighted.


■ The Confession Room, Jack, and staff roll movies can now be skipped by pressing the ESC key.


■ The appearance condition of the girl who appears at the end has been further relaxed, and whispering can be heard to make the condition easier to understand.


■ In addition to re-encoding some movies using software, we reviewed and changed various data and succeeded in a 1GB diet.



If you have any problems, please report them.
We will respond as quickly as possible.
